subject: general
question: What is the compound interest (in Rs.) on a sum of Rs. 31600 for 1(1)/(3) years at 9% p.a., when the interest is compounded 8-monthly? (Nearest to a Rs.)
solution:
Given:

Principal = Rs.31600

Time = 1 (1)/(3) years or 16 months 

Rate = 9% Per annum 

⇒ Rate as per 8-monthly basis = 8/12 × 9 = 6% 

Formulas used:

Compound Interest = Amount - Principal
